name: breast_cancer_wdbc
outcome_definition: Binary malignant vs benign diagnosis from digitized fine-needle-aspirate (FNA) biopsy images of a breast mass (Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer set). A same-sample diagnostic classification from biopsy-derived morphometric features (the CONFIRMING step of the mammography -> breast MRI -> biopsy workup), not a longitudinal screening/early-detection task on its own - mammography/MRI screening imagery is a separate, unimplemented modality this pipeline does not ingest.
display_name: Breast cancer diagnosis (WDBC biopsy features, tabular)

clinical_context.this_pipeline_covers: biopsy-derived morphometric features (digitized FNA image measurements) - the confirming step
clinical_context.gap: mammography/MRI screening imagery is not ingested by this pipeline; only post-biopsy tabular measurements are

data_source.citation: Wolberg, Street & Mangasarian, UCI Machine Learning Repository - Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic)
data_source.access: bundled with scikit-learn (sklearn.datasets.load_breast_cancer) - no download or license review needed, see data/breast_cancer_wdbc/prepare.py
